verdict.rationale: Pika's own marketing says it can "create short clips or full videos from your references" (pika-docs-9), and Motion Transfer adds moves from reference videos (pika-docs-15). That covers generating footage from a reference, but nothing explicitly says the output adopts the reference's visual style. Restyling is only documented for images (pika-docs-5), and the evidence is marketing taglines with no depth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of style transfer from a reference video or image to new footage, detail on how references guide style, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
